laundering_patterns.name: Reviewer edits clinical dosage and strips model provenance
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: A reviewer with human origin creates a new proposal that references the same commitment but omits inference_context_binding_id while editing target.dosage, attempting to strip model lineage.

laundering_patterns.name: Model origin attempts base_version_only binding mode
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: An attacker sets origin="model" with context_binding_mode="base_version_only" to bypass THSS snapshot validation.

laundering_patterns.name: Downgrade consumed-THSS lineage to base_version_only via reviewed proposal
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: A reviewed proposal retains reviewed_proposal_id but switches context_binding_mode to base_version_only while root consumed THSS.

laundering_patterns.name: Substitute inference_context_binding_id with a different binding
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: A proposal references a valid but different inference binding than the root proposal to redirect lineage without detection.

laundering_patterns.name: Re-present snapshot without consumed-THSS binding
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: A non-model origin proposal consumes a snapshot that has a persisted consumed_thss=true binding but omits inference_context_binding_id.

laundering_patterns.name: Exceed maximum proposal lineage depth
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: An attacker constructs a chain of reviewed_proposal_id references exceeding MAX_PROPOSAL_LINEAGE_DEPTH (4) to overflow lineage traversal.

laundering_patterns.name: Create a cyclic parent-ID reference in proposal lineage
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: An attacker crafts proposals where reviewed_proposal_id creates A->B->A cycle to cause infinite traversal.

laundering_patterns.name: Direct SQL INSERT bypassing ORM with base_version_only + model origin
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: Direct PostgreSQL INSERT of a proposal row with origin="model" AND context_binding_mode="base_version_only" to bypass Python-level guards.

laundering_patterns.name: Direct SQL INSERT with binding_id but NULL snapshot fields
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: Direct INSERT setting inference_context_binding_id with source_snapshot_id=NULL to decouple binding from snapshot proof.

laundering_patterns.name: Reviewer modifies proposal but retains original proposal_digest
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: Craft a reviewed proposal that modifies fields in the envelope but keeps the original proposal_digest, attempting to pass digest validation.

laundering_patterns.name: Valid positive control: correct snapshot-bound reviewed proposal
laundering_patterns.threat_vector: Correctly formed reviewed proposal with valid root binding, matching snapshot, and proper lineage.

primary_analysis.endpoint: Primary: zero adversarial laundering proposals admitted across 250 negative schedules and 100% clean-control acceptance across 50 positive schedules (300 total executions).
primary_analysis.route_inventory_scope: All 5 write routes: propose_bound_commitment_transition, propose_base_commitment_transition, review_model_commitment_proposal, apply_commitment_transition, and direct SQL boundary (CHECK constraints)
primary_analysis.fail_closed_criteria: Any single adversarial admission is a protocol failure requiring code remediation before release.
